1.explanation: The code sets up a menu with items that have long text. The `title` attribute is added to each item to simulate the bug scenario where tooltips appear on hover. This demonstrates the issue of tooltips showing identical text to the menu item, which some users find problematic.
1.bug_scenario: The bug involves the automatic addition of a title attribute to menu items, which causes a tooltip to appear when hovering over items with long text. This behavior is intended to support accessibility and display truncated text, but it conflicts with WCAG guidelines when the title and innerText are identical. The images show tooltips appearing over menu items with long text, which some users find undesirable.
